properties.displayName: [Baseline] Virtual machines should use a system-assigned managed identity
properties.description: Audits virtual machines that do not have a system-assigned managed identity. Managed identities let workloads authenticate to Azure services without credentials in code or config, and are a prerequisite for guest configuration, Azure Monitor Agent, and most modern management extensions.

metadata.description: Audit reports VMs without a system-assigned identity; Disabled turns the policy off.
